verdict.rationale: Stable documents a REST API (x-api-key authentication, MailItem and Location endpoints, webhooks), but nothing in the evidence mentions an official SDK or client library in any language. A raw HTTP API is a building block, not an SDK, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404, so there is no published spec for generating clients either. An SaaS API product could plausibly ship SDKs, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence means none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
